answer: The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in mirror, expire in tide, and relic lists each expiry. Anyone running 10 aliases as a result needs 95 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2057 identities would post 3336 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
